newsitem.title: USA: Cairn Energy USA adopts holder rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Cairn Energy USA adopts holder rights plan.

text.p: Cairn Energy USA Inc said a shareholder rights plan adopted unanimously by its board became effective on Tuesday after getting lender approvals.
Cairn had previously announced it had retained the investment banking firm of Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette to assist it in exploring strategic alternatives.

"The company felt it was prudent to ensure an orderly process as it studies alternatives to maximize shareholder value. The shareholder rights plan is designed to protect the interest of shareholders during this process," Cairn said in a release.
Separately, the company also said that two directors, James Alexander and Thomas Hix, had resigned from its board.
